correctness.rationale: Riemann–Hurwitz: y³=x8+ax4+1 has genus 7 and quotient v³=t4+at²+1 genus 3; involution x→-x gives degree-two cover ramified at three t=0 points and infinity, so Prym dimension 4. f'=x³(3x4+4a); simultaneous root gives a²+1=0, hence smooth parameter U. Seven regular differentials A0,A1,B0..B4 form a basis. Direct coefficient extraction for Cartier yields A0↦(3a)^(1/5)B0+B4, A1↦[3(1+a²)]^(1/5)B1, B0↦a^(1/5)A0, B1↦A1, B2,B3↦0, B4↦A0. Thus C²(A0)=(1+3a6)^(1/25)A0, C²(A1)=[3(1+a²)]^(1/25)A1, with stable ranks 2 vs 4 on C and 0 vs 2 on anti-invariant Prym; one-step ranks fix a-numbers 3,1,2. Separability of H=1+3a6 and its disjointness from discriminant imply six distinct geometric smooth exceptional parameters. Independent F25 field arithmetic counted 23 smooth and 6 exceptional parameters; extrapolation is by polynomial/algebraic proof, not F25 enumeration. Inspected actual verify_cartier.py and exact RESULT.md blobs.
